name: eucalyptus globulus leaf
uses: Uses • treats head, pubic (crab), and body lice.
otcwarn: Warnings For external use only. Do not use • on eyes • inside nose, mouth or vagina. • on lice in eyebrows or eyelashes. See a doctor if lice are present in these areas When using this product • keep eyes tightly closed and protect eyes with a washcloth or towel. • if product gets in eyes, flush with water right away • scalp itching or redness may occur Stop use and ask a doctor if • eye irritation occurs • scalp itching or redness continues or infection occurs. Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
